role_key.V: Government entity of a country other than gov

definitions.unit: One cached article record and its prioritized primary action; not distinct real-world events.
definitions.eligibility: Gov and action identified, align/rep/frame each -1/0/+1. Zeros retained.
definitions.source_scope: Source domain matches, evaluated government KEN, publication country KEN.
definitions.negative_share: Negative records / all common-eligible records in this cell.
definitions.net: (Positive records - negative records) / all common-eligible records.
definitions.cube_order: 27 cells: align, rep, frame nested in that order, each -1,0,+1.
definitions.role: Institutional role, not automatically incumbent affiliation.
definitions.other_act: Residual category retained in all denominators; not interpreted as a substantive action type.

limits: Same source-month and action/role categories are not matched-event comparisons.
Article genres, story selection, source completeness and repeated coverage may differ.
Descriptive model labels do not establish outlet bias, accuracy or public opinion.
No sampling-independence assumption, confidence interval or significance claim is made.
Zero includes mixed or insufficient directional evidence, not just neutral wording.
